import re

def parse(lines):
    rows = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    kvrec = {}
    kvlines = []
    pc = 34
    lc = 43
    cur = None
    main = re.compile(r'^(\S+)\s+(up|down)\s+(up|down)(?:\s+(?!-->)(\S+))?(?:\s+(?!-->)(\S+))?(?:\s+-->\s+(\S+))?$')
    cont = re.compile(r'^(\s+)(\S+)(?:\s+(?!-->)(\S+))?(?:\s+-->\s+(\S+))?$')
    ctx = re.compile(r'^\s*\{(?P<role>[\w-]+):(?P<slot>[\w-]+)\}\s*$')
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        s = l.rstrip()
        m = ctx.match(s)
        if m:
            kvrec['RE role'] = m.group('role')
            kvrec['RE slot'] = m.group('slot')
            kvlines.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\s*Interface\s+Admin\s+Link', s):
            p = s.find('Proto')
            if p > 0:
                pc = p
            p = s.find('Local')
            if p > 0:
                lc = p
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = main.match(s)
        if m:
            cur = {'Interface': m.group(1), 'Admin': m.group(2), 'Link': m.group(3), 'Proto': m.group(4) or ''}
            row = dict(cur)
            row['Local'] = m.group(5) or ''
            row['Remote'] = m.group(6) or ''
            rows.append(row)
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = cont.match(s)
        if m and cur is not None:
            if len(m.group(1)) > (pc + lc) // 2:
                local = m.group(2)
                remote = m.group(4) or ''
                if m.group(3):
                    remote = m.group(3) if not remote else remote
            else:
                cur['Proto'] = m.group(2)
                local = m.group(3) or ''
                remote = m.group(4) or ''
            row = dict(cur)
            row['Local'] = local
            row['Remote'] = remote
            rows.append(row)
            used.append(i)
            continue
        skip.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if rows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'interfaces', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows})
    if kvrec:
        blocks.append({'name': 'routing_engine', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kvlines, 'records': [kvrec]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
